history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - keep-or-drop decision needed. This is a Presbyterian church in Thenzawl, Serchhip district, Mizoram, under the Presbyterian Church of India (Mizoram Synod). Thenzawl is a predominantly Christian town with several local Presbyterian congregations (map listings show Thenzawl Vengthar, Thenzawl Dinthar Veng and Thenzawl Vengthlang Presbyterian churches), so the generic name 'Thenzawl Presbyterian Church' is ambiguous and may not correspond to a single named congregation; coordinates are the Thenzawl town centroid and should be treated as approximate. CSV state column was wrong (held the town name); actual state is Mizoram. No overlap with an existing dataset file; id differs from 2466.json (Darjeeling Peace Pagoda).

town_description: Thenzawl is a town in Serchhip district, Mizoram, known as a handloom centre famous for Mizo puan weaving. Set amid rolling hills, it is a gateway to attractions such as Vantawng Falls and the Thenzawl golf course, and is overwhelmingly Christian.
